# Shader Workshop {.unnumbered}

This workshop was given at [IHP](https://www.ihp.fr/) in Paris, February 2026.
It is a short introduction to shader programming as a tool for mathematical illustration and exploration.

Shaders are programs that run in parallel on the GPU, making them exceptionally fast for visualization tasks.
We write code that "reads like mathematics" using a beginner-friendly web-based platform called Shadertoy, which handles all the low-level programming complexities.

No prior experience with shaders or GLSL is required—only a foundation in undergraduate mathematics and willingness to experiment with code.
